Create, start, stop, pause, resume, fork, recover and delete isolates and microVMs.

## List sandboxes

`GET /v1/sandboxes` (SDK method `listSandboxes`)

The account's sandboxes the caller may see, newest first: by default the ones starting, running or stopping; `all` adds stopped, paused and errored ones. Deleted ones are left out. A key needs `sandboxes:read`.

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account` | string | no | The account to act in: the caller's personal account (the default for a person) or an organisation they belong to. An API key always acts in its own account, and naming another is `forbidden`. |
| `state` | [SandboxState](/api/reference/types/#sandboxstate) | no | `starting`: being placed and booted. `running`: commands run now. `stopping`: its disk is being saved. `stopped`: no machine; its disk is kept as its newest snapshot, and running programs are gone. `paused`: like `stopped`, but its memory is kept too, so `resume` carries on where it left off (microVMs only). `error`: the last operation failed or the machine was lost; `recover` or `resume` it. `deleting`, `deleted`: erased for good, with its snapshots. |
| `all` | boolean | no | Include stopped, paused and errored sandboxes. Default: only active ones. |
| `label` | Record&lt;string, string&gt; | no | Only those with each label: `label.ticket=PROJ-12`. |
| `limit` | integer | no | At most this many; default 50. (minimum 1, maximum 500) |
| `cursor` | string | no | A previous page's `nextCursor`. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SandboxPage](/api/reference/types/#sandboxpage) (`application/json`). A page of sandboxes.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Create a sandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes` (SDK method `createSandbox`)

Makes a sandbox and starts it: an isolate unless `type` says `microvm`, from a snapshot when `from` names one. Answers as soon as it is placed (`starting`), or once it runs with `wait`. A full deployment is `exhausted`; no host able to run the type is `unavailable`. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry may be `conflict`: retry it later. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [CreateSandboxBody](/api/reference/types/#createsandboxbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `429` exhausted, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Change a sandbox

`PATCH /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}` (SDK method `updateSandbox`)

Renames it, changes its auto-stop or moves its stop time (`extendMinutes`), shares it with its organisation or makes it private again, or replaces its labels. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Body**: [UpdateSandboxBody](/api/reference/types/#updatesandboxbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Delete a sandbox permanently

`DELETE /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}` (SDK method `deleteSandbox`)

Erases it and its automatic snapshots for good; saved snapshots of it stay. It can't be undone. A key needs `sandboxes:delete`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox, deleting.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Start a sandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/start` (SDK method `startSandbox`)

Boots a stopped, paused or errored sandbox fresh from its newest disk snapshot: programs start again, and a paused sandbox's memory is let go. To carry on where a paused sandbox left off, `resume` it instead. A running sandbox is answered as it is. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Body**: [ResumeSandboxBody](/api/reference/types/#resumesandboxbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox, starting.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `429` exhausted, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Stop or pause a sandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/stop` (SDK method `stopSandbox`)

Saves its disk as a snapshot and lets the machine go; running programs end. With `keepMemory`, pauses it instead, keeping its memory too (microVMs only; `not_supported` on an isolate). A stopped sandbox costs nothing to run. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Body**: [StopSandboxBody](/api/reference/types/#stopsandboxbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox, stopping.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Resume a sandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/resume` (SDK method `resumeSandbox`)

Carries on a paused sandbox from its memory, or starts a stopped one from its newest snapshot, on the same size or the one given. Same ID; a new machine. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Body**: [ResumeSandboxBody](/api/reference/types/#resumesandboxbody)

**Answers**

- `200`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox, starting.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `429` exhausted, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Fork a sandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/fork` (SDK method `forkSandbox`)

Makes `count` new sandboxes, each a copy of this one's newest snapshot (or `snapshotId`); a running microVM on a host that can fork live is copied with its memory. The source doesn't change. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Header parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | string | no | A key of your choosing, unique per call, such as a UUID. A retry with the same key gets the first call's answer and does nothing again. While the first call is still working, a retry may be `conflict`: retry it later. (at most 255 characters) |

**Body**: [ForkSandboxBody](/api/reference/types/#forksandboxbody)

**Answers**

- `201`: [ForkedSandboxes](/api/reference/types/#forkedsandboxes) (`application/json`). The new sandboxes.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `429` exhausted, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Recover a sandbox

`POST /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/recover` (SDK method `recoverSandbox`)

Restarts the machine of a sandbox that doesn't answer or is in `error`, on its disk as it is. Memory is lost. A key needs `sandboxes:write`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Answers**

- `200`: [Sandbox](/api/reference/types/#sandbox) (`application/json`). The sandbox, starting.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found, `409` conflict, `501` not_supported, `503` unavailable. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).

## Get a sandbox's usage

`GET /v1/sandboxes/{sandboxId}/usage` (SDK method `getSandboxUsage`)

CPU, memory, running time and cost per interval. A key needs `sandboxes:read`.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `sandboxId` | string | yes | The sandbox's ID. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `since` | integer | no | From this time; default 24 hours ago. |
| `intervalSeconds` | integer | no | Default 300. (minimum 60, maximum 86400) |

**Answers**

- `200`: [SandboxUsage](/api/reference/types/#sandboxusage) (`application/json`). The usage.

**Errors**: `400` invalid, `401` unauthenticated, `403` forbidden, `404` not_found. Each is an [ErrorBody](/api/reference/types/#errorbody).
